{{Quote|The envoy was a puppet.''"<br />"''They always are, but they remain the public face of the Emperor. To slight one of them is to slight him.|Eldon Ax and Darth Chratis|<ref name="Tor Fatal Alliance" />}}
'''Ia Nirvin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] and [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was sent by the Empire to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], in order to bid on several items that were offered by the Hutts in an auction and came from a spaceship named ''[[Cinzia]]''. He was killed during the [[Skirmish in Tassaa Bareesh's palace|skirmish]] in [[Tassaa Bareesh]]'s palace.<ref name="Tor Fatal Alliance" />
